summary: Completed full backend (pytest, 18/18 passing) and frontend (Playwright e2e) testing of SeriesTrack. All auth, public TMDB endpoints, library, calendar, notifications, stats, and frontend flows (splash, login, dashboard rails, search, series detail, library, calendar, notifications, profile/logout) work as expected.

minor.issue: When using a requests.Session that previously called /api/auth/login, the unauth call still returns 200 because the backend ALSO sets httpOnly cookies (samesite=none, secure). Not a bug per se — the dual cookie+Bearer model works — but means cookies are silently authenticating session-based clients in addition to Bearer. CORS allow_credentials=False is fine since the frontend uses Bearer. Considered acceptable.

issues: Featured hero (The Boys) backdrop image did not render in screenshot — likely lazy-load or slow image; the title + CTA buttons are visible. Worth verifying that the backdrop image URL renders consistently on first paint.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager for future-proofing.

set_auth_cookies() is called even though the cross-origin model relies on Bearer. Cookies are effectively dead-weight for the preview URL and may cause confusion for testers (session-based clients become silently authenticated). Either remove cookies or document explicitly.
calendar/upcoming makes one TMDB call per library item serially — N+1 latency. Should use asyncio.gather for parallelism if libraries grow.
ObjectId(payload['sub']) in get_current_user has no try/except; a malformed token sub would raise a 500 instead of 401. Wrap in try/except bson.errors.InvalidId.
Library upsert always inserts a new notification on every status change/upsert — can spam the notifications list. Consider deduping or only notifying on first add.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 18 pytest backend tests pass against https://show-notify.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend tests located at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Note: the backend's EmailStr rejects RFC-reserved TLDs like .test — use real-style TLDs (.com) for new test emails. Backend sets httpOnly cookies AND returns access_token in body; frontend uses Bearer header only. Admin seeded via startup hook (checked existing — does NOT update password if admin already exists; flag if password is rotated). Frontend e2e covered: splash, /register-related testids, /login, /dashboard rails, /search, /series/1396 with all 4 status actions + season tab, /library tabs + stats + remove, /calendar grid + filters + prev/next, /notifications with mark-all, /profile stats + logout. Library remove cleanup performed at end of run.
